zh-Hans: 至少跟上你还是能做到的！
en: I can at least keep up!

zh-Hans: 这不是挺势均力敌的吗？
en: We're pretty evenly matched, aren't we?
Damn, I can't push any harder!
A little horsepower difference means nothing!

zh-Hans: 你也太强了吧，到哪儿都能横着走了！
en: You're too damn good! Is there anyone who can beat you?

zh-Hans: 跟不上！开玩笑吧，到底怎么回事？
en: I can't keep up! You're kidding me. What's going on?

zh-Hans: 贴得这么紧，像在催我一样，根本静不下心来！
en: He's right on my bumper! I can't relax with him rushing me like this!
Time to pick up the pace.
Let's open that gap a little more!
I might be in trouble here.
Damn it, he's all over me!
This is bad! He won't let up!
I've got a two-liter turbo, you know!
This is just a Sunday drive.
Even Itsuki would put up more of a fight.

zh-Hans: 别看我这样，我在 SPEED STARS 里可是排得进前三的！
en: Believe it or not, I'm one of the top three in the Speed Stars!
